train_ttad_model: train a text to action dictionary model using GPU with configurable epochs and batch size
evaluate_ttad_model: evaluate a pre-trained TTAD model on validation and test sets for accuracy
configure_ttad_data_sampling: configure data resampling mode and hard example buffer probability for TTAD training
configure_ttad_model_architecture: configure TTAD model recursion type, sentence encoder, attention heads, and model dimension
save_load_ttad_checkpoints: save TTAD model checkpoints per epoch and load a model file for evaluation
